messages:
Emma: starting dogfood run for sable-3b-q (int8) against the funcall/structured-output suite — 5k queries, sampling production prompts. main ask: compare funcall JSON compliance vs float baseline, watching parse failures and wrong-action rates. @Raj @Li FYI
Raj: thanks — can you paste the initial pass metrics when available? interested in parse failure delta, retry count distribution, and any suffix-noise traces.
CanaryBot: canary run 4876543210 started by Emma at 2026-03-21T15:04:20Z — running 5000 queries across 3 shards.
CanaryBot: initial summary (after shard1): parse_fail_rate=6.9% (+2.7% vs baseline), wrong_action_rate=1.4% (+0.6%), avg_retries_per_failed=1.8, median_latency+12ms. detailed logs uploaded to s3://redwood-canary/4876543210/shard1.log
Li: interesting — looks like a lot of the parse failures are suffix-truncation and missing trailing bracket. suspect kv-prefix caching + quantized tokenization boundary changes. saw more partial JSON fragments in logs.
Sasha: also saw an uptick in duplicate tool-invokes when the agent retried — retry budget kicks in and we sometimes get the same action twice because toolcall ack is slower on the canary infra. might be contributing to wrong_action_rate.
Emma: example failing output (one of many) — note missing "action" key and trailing commas:
```
{"tool_call": {"name": "get_weather",
 "args": {"location": "Boston",},
 "meta": {"confidence": 0.81}
 // missing "action" and trailing bracket chopped
```
Raj: Yikes. Two quick experiments: (A) rerun with prefix-caching disabled and max_output_tokens +64 to see if boundary/kv-cache is the culprit; (B) rerun with tokenizer-alignment check (compare token splits of prompt+prefix between float and int8) to isolate tokenization drift.
Li: we should also try a soft-repair layer (json-wrapping heuristics) as an intermediate mitigation — note this fixed ~50% of suffix-truncations previously but increased silent-action-misassignments in one case. tradeoff to quantify.
Sasha: another variable: batching parameters. int8 runtime auto-batched at slightly different cut points; try forcing batch_size=1 for a sample to see if that reduces noise. also increase retry backoff and add idempotency token in toolcall envelope to avoid duplicates.
Emma: agree. plan: 1) run A/B across 1k queries each: (control) float baseline, (canary-1) int8 w/ no-kv-cache, (canary-2) int8 with batch_size=1 + idempotency, (canary-3) int8 + soft-repair wrapper. 2) capture parse_fail_rate, wrong_action_rate, duplicate-toolcalls, retry_counts, and tokenization-diffs. 3) upload artifacts and attach to the ticket. I'll kick off jobs in 20m and post links.
Raj: add a small eval harness that fuzzes trailing whitespace/escape sequences — those seem to correlate with the broken cases. canary should sample those aggressively.
Li: note to self — check quantization toolchain flags; previous PTQ pass used per-channel scaling which changed some special token encodings. will confirm.
CanaryBot: scheduled reruns: canary-1 id=4876543211, canary-2 id=4876543212, canary-3 id=4876543213. artifacts will appear in s3:/redwood-canary/4876543210/variants/
Sasha: I'll add a short dashboard tile to console showing parse_fail_rate by variant and a hook for sampling raw model text for failed cases.
Emma: opened ticket RDW-2198 with the plan and links to the canary artifacts. assigning to @Li and @Sasha. ETA for first A/B results ~ 2 hours. :mag:
Raj: thanks — if any variant shows >1% wrong_action delta we hold the rollout.
Li: copying notes into the onboarding doc for sable-3b-q quant pipeline.
Sasha: thumbs up.
Emma: will update after first results. :eyes:
